events.title: House Specific Vol 3: Dantiez Saunderson +12 DJS 2 FLOORS
events.description:
Hey... you ..."House" it going? Lets get your December kick off started right! This is Volume 3 of a our House Music Event Series called HOUSE SPECIFIC ! On December 5th! Join us at The Old Shillelagh in Downtown Detroit Inside Greektown! THIS IS A SUPER HUGE 3 FLOOR BAR we are taking over the 2nd and 3rd floor for our event. We got a super awesome fun night jam packed and filled with 13 music artist performances including a set from the one and only !! DANTIEZ SAUNDERSON !! and coming to support we have 12 incredible local artists and producers playing the grooviest vibes all night: Illuminosity, Hot Pxl, JT, Damselfly, Blush, Adrian Mason, K-lala, N8, Cheüque, Pocket Presence, Melbeatz and Smith & Reckless.
2 FLOORS, FLOOR 2+3, MANY BARS ALL OVER INSIDE + HEATED PATIO AND SMOKE AREA 13DJS !! Bring your friends and have fun tickets will start at 25$. must be 21+ to enter. Easy-Paid parking available all around the venue (SOME FREE PARKING AVAILABLE AS WELL) + ORDER FOOD FROM ANY FLOOR UNTILL 11PM
Any Questions you can Direct Message us @bootscatsdetroit on Instagram or Boots & Cats Detroit on Facebook!
